import unittest

class Contract(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_contract(self):
        import grouping as m
        pairs = [('a', 1), ('b', 0), ('a', 2)]
        self.assertEqual(m.group(iter(pairs)), {'a': [1, 2], 'b': [0]})
        self.assertEqual(pairs, [('a', 1), ('b', 0), ('a', 2)])
        self.assertEqual(m.group(iter([])), {})
